title: Oryx customer implementation journal
content:
Daily scratch / implementation journal - Oryx (personal).

2026-03-03 — initial intake call notes:
- Customer: Oryx HealthTech (on-prem, air-gapped request). Wants Redwood Private install behind their firewall; compliance: HIPAA + SOC2.
- Primary ask: <2s p99 text gen latency for short prompts (<=256 tokens), dedicated batch throughput for nightly scoring job (20k reqs/hr).
- Ops contact: Jordan L. (vpn + jump host owner), Security: Pri C.
- They will provide 4x A100 equivalent nodes (on-prem cluster). Need guidance on model quantization, KV cache sizing, and KMS plan.

Quick bullets / action items (personal TODO):
- [ ] Draft initial runbook for on-prem install (installer + config hints) — include offline KMS flow. Target: 2026-03-05.
- [ ] Validate model variant selection with Research (optimize for latency vs cost) — ping Mateo.
- [x] Confirm SFTP channel for artifact transfer (done; got host + creds placeholder).
- [ ] Prepare smoke test curl commands and expected response checks for customer signoff.
- [ ] Run throughput sim locally against quantized 3B and 7B variants to get baseline numbers.
- [ ] Document fallback routing policy for Dedicated->Hosted if Private capacity saturated (customer asked about DR).

Notes from config play: (rough, do not copy verbatim to runbook until cleaned)
- Proposed runtime config for Oryx on 4 GPU nodes:
  - instance_type: a100-40gb
  - num_nodes: 4 (allow 1 spare for maintenance)
  - cuda_streams_per_gpu: 2 (start conservative)
  - max_batch_tokens: 2048 (monitor and adjust)
  - kv_cache_shards: 8 (spread across nodes)
  - prefetch_kv: true
  - quantization_profile: int8-fast (test int8-approx for quality regressions)

Operator hints / commands to include in runbook (copyable):
- systemd unit snippet:
  [Unit]
  Description=redwood-runtime
  After=network.target

  [Service]
  Type=simple
  ExecStart=/opt/redwood/bin/runtime --config /etc/redwood/runtime-config.yaml
  Restart=on-failure

- quick smoke curl (post-install):
  curl -sS -X POST https://localhost:8443/v1/generate
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>'
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
    -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-q8","input":"Write a two-sentence summary of the daily standup."}' | jq '.output[0].text'

- expected smoke checks:
  - HTTP 200 within 500ms on local loopback for single-token short prompt
  - deterministic-ish output shape: array length > 0, tokens < 64 for test prompt
  - memory footprint under node GPU memory budget (monitor with nvidia-smi and runtime logs)

Security / KMS notes (open question):
- Customer prefers their own HSM. We need to confirm PKCS11 interface + RHSM support.
- Offline artifacts: signed tarball transfer via SFTP; validate signature on install. Add checklist for key import:
  1) customer provides public cert / key handle
  2) operator runs 'redwood-key-import --hsm pkcs11://slot/0 --key-file signed.key'
  3) confirm 'redwood-key-status' shows key loaded and usable

Model & quality:
- Recommended start: redwood-7b-q8 for balance of latency/quality. Plan to test redwood-3b-q8 for batch scoring pipeline (cost save).
- Need to collect 200 sample prompts from Oryx (Jordan) for eval set; send template asking for distribution across prompt lengths.

Rollout plan (sketch):
- Phase 0: Preflight — network, jump host, SFTP transfer, HSM cert validation (2 days)
- Phase 1: Install runtime + models on 2-node pilot (customer dev cluster) — run smoke tests, perf baselining (1 week)
- Phase 2: Scale to 4-node prod, run nightly scoring job, enable autoscale policy tweaks, monitoring set up (2–3 days)
- Phase 3: Cutover + observed 48h support window; offer runbook + 30-day operational handoff (SLA doc attached separately)

Monitoring & observability checklist (notes for Redwood Console config):
- Per-route latency p50/p95/p99 dashboards, token-level cost estimates for scoring job.
- Tracing hook: enable sampling of 1% for traces while in pilot; bump to 5% post-cutover for first 48h.
- Alerts: p99 > 2s (critical), error-rate > 0.5% (warning).

Open questions for next sync (to bring up with Jordan and security lead):
- Can they provide a test HSM or a dev-mode KMS for validation? If not, plan for local software KMS with encrypted key import as stopgap.
- Network egress policy: will they allow outbound telemetry to Redwood Console endpoints? If not, we need offline log bundling plan.
- Any constraints on ports or proxies for inter-node KV communication? Need exact firewall rules.

Random quick logs / thoughts (brain dump):
- Mateo recommended running 7b with dynamic batching tuned to 16 concurrent requests at 128 token avg — try in sim.
- Consider offering a small Redwood-managed backup node (Dedicated) for DR — price this and include as optional line item.
- Make sure to include explicit instructions for bumping max_batch_tokens live and rolling restart behavior.

Next immediate steps (today):
1) Draft preflight checklist skeleton and share with Evan for review (Evan: please add K8s vs systemd notes).
2) Send sample prompt template to Jordan (quick email draft below).
3) Schedule perf sim run with Mateo for 2026-03-06.

Email draft to Jordan (paste-able):
Subject: Oryx - sample prompts + preflight info

Hi Jordan,

Quick follow-up from our intake call — can you please share 200 sample prompts representative of your workload (mix of short support replies, medium-length summaries, and long-form synthesis)? A spreadsheet with one prompt per row + a column "intent/type" would be ideal. Also can you confirm whether you can provide a dev HSM or if we should plan for a software-based encrypted key import for pilot?

Thanks,
Samira (Redwood SE)

-- end of journal entry for 2026-03-03.

(Will update after perf run and when Evan sends his notes)
